Venture Diary

15 Aug to 20 Oct 2026

Saturday, 15 August

Day one: GLOOD becomes a venture

Present: JasMehr

After joining LM Thapar, the class learnt that the Entrepreneurship subject asks every group to run a real venture. JasMehr decided to grow GLOOD, the sticker brand he was already running, instead of starting from zero. His reasoning, written down for the team: blank laptops, bottles and phone cases are boring, and a Rs 20 sticker is the cheapest way for a student to show what they are into, whether that is F1, anime, memes or music.

Sold since last entry

  • 1 x Box Box Box sticker · Rs 50
  • Total Rs 50

For laughs

Head office for now: one hostel bed and one laptop.

Note for the team

Stock is thin. A print run is needed this weekend.

logged by JasMehr

The whole day went into a print shop in Sector 17: final checks on the designs, printing the sticker sheets and getting a large "FREE STICKERS!" poster made for stall days.

Saturday, 10 October

Kaladhara 3.0, day 2

Present: Full team

Early in the morning the team did the DMart bulk run and packed the car so full there was no space left inside. On the way back the police stopped the car and asked why it was so packed. One explanation about a college stall later, the team made it back in time to open. Day two was GLOOD's biggest day so far.
